GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

3. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

5. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

16. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
